script: You are made of stardust. The hydrogen in your body formed soon after the Big Bang, about 13.8 billion years ago. Most of the oxygen and carbon in you was made inside stars. When those stars died, they scattered these elements into space. Some of the gold on Earth may have come from crashing neutron stars. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
